@graph.name: Kanha National Park
@graph.description: Tiger reserve of about 2,000 sq km in Mandla and Balaghat districts of Madhya Pradesh, home to the Bengal tiger and the hard-ground barasingha. Core zones: Kisli, Kanha, Mukki and Sarhi.

mainEntity.name: What is the location of Kanha National Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Madhya Pradesh's Mandla and Balaghat districts are home to Kanha National Park.

mainEntity.name: What kinds of animals live in Kanha National Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can witness a number of birds, as well as Bengal tigers, barasingha, leopards, sloth bears, gaur, and wild dogs.

mainEntity.name: What is the best time of year to go to Kanha National Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: The optimum time to go is from October to June, and summer is the best time to see tigers.

mainEntity.name: How can I make a reservation for a safari in Kanha National Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book through safari operators who arrange permits, jeep safaris, guides, and accommodation
